Title: The Sun Pharoh takes night classes [LSJ]

Messages.Author: Santiago
Messages.Body:
What happens if I give Akhenaten the Sargon Fragment? Can he play
necromancy cards at superior? His text claims that he can play
necromancy cards as a vampire with basic necromancy, so does he fall
under the "vampire" referred to in the first sentence on the Fragment?

Sargon Fragment, The
Equipment
1 pool
Unique Equipment. The vampire with this equipment gains superior
Necromancy. This vampire can move a library card from your ash heap to
your hand as an action that costs 1 blood. Discard down to your
maximum hand size afterward.
